certificate.title: Certificate template
certificate.intro: Design the certificate by choosing from the settings below; the preview updates as you go. The trainee and training details are filled in automatically when certificates are issued.
certificate.resetConfirm: All design and text settings return to the default certificate. Uploaded images are kept. Nothing changes until you save.
certificate.leaveMessage: You have unsaved changes to the certificate template. If you leave now, they will be lost.
certificate.previewNote: Shown with fictional sample values. This is not a real certificate, and the QR code is only a placeholder.

fields.qrPosition: QR code position (bottom of the page)

hints.preset: Choosing a design applies its recommended fonts, border and background. You can still change each setting.
hints.footer: A short line at the bottom of the certificate, for example the company address.
hints.dataPlaceholders: The certificate always shows the trainee's name, training field, university, training period, total training hours, overall grade and the trainer's comment. They come from the training record when certificates are issued and cannot be typed here.
hints.image: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 512 KB. Changes to images are saved immediately.
hints.trainerName: Whether the trainer's name appears on certificates is still an open decision, so it can be turned on or off here.
hints.qr: Placeholder only: the verification QR code is created when certificates are issued.
